version.changelog:
ruitian-html 1.0.0

- 首发发布：生成专业美观的企业级 HTML 文档
- 提供紫色渐变主题与卡片式圆角布局，响应式设计，移动端友好
- 支持渐变蓝色表头表格、可视化流程图与架构图
- 内置导航栏、章节目录、Hero Section、卡片化内容展示、页脚
- 支持离线 Base64 图片嵌入与最佳实践示范
- 适用于项目报告、技术方案、企业内部文档等多种场景

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only HTML document/template generator that requests no credentials, installs, or privileged access and its instructions align with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (enterprise HTML reports, purple gradient, responsive cards, tables, simple flow diagrams) match the provided SKILL.md and template.html. No unrelated binaries, env vars, or services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to generating HTML (full output or stepwise building) and reference template.html. They explicitly note CDN usage for Bootstrap/icons. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md/file tree mention an optional scripts/generate.py, but no script file is present in the package—this is likely benign documentation mismatch but worth noting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or written by an installer; the only external dependencies referenced are public CDNs for Bootstrap and icons, which is expected for an HTML template.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The skill does not ask for secrets or unrelated access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No always:true, no persistent/system-level changes, and the skill is user-invocable only. It does not request to modify other skills or agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: generate enterprise-style HTML templates. Before installing or using it, consider: (1) the template relies on public CDNs (Bootstrap, Bootstrap Icons) so network access is required — if you need fully offline artifacts, embed assets locally or convert images to Base64 as suggested; (2) there is no code execution or credential access in the package, but avoid pasting sensitive data into generated documents; (3) the README/SKILL.md mention an optional generate.py that is not included—if you expected automation, confirm whether a generation script is provided by the author; (4) review template.html for any external script tags before serving it publicly. Overall the package is internally consistent and contains no disproportionate requirements.
